sourceMetadata.sourceTitle: I just can't take anymore of this. I need a permanent cure
sourceMetadata.whyUnprimed: The poster explicitly distinguishes physical symptom burden from fear and asks for coping, not for reassurance that it is anxiety.
route: Medical red-flag/current-cardiology status and suicide-risk check.
Separate objective medical status, symptom burden, psychological amplification, functional cost, and treatment burden.
Do not diagnose anxiety as the cause.
Use coping/acceptance support only as adjunct to appropriate medical follow-up.
Outcome review includes burden even if the condition is medically characterized as low risk.
sourceMetadata.defectFound: The original regulation lane could reduce a physical burden to anxiety or avoidance.
sourceMetadata.implementedImprovement: Map 12 creates a chronic-physical-symptom lane and explicitly prohibits 'just anxiety' reduction.
